AccountExport.description:
Everything Tablr holds about the caller.

Backs `GET /v1/me/export`. The field list doubles as the checklist
for "what is in scope for a data request" — see the PII table in
`backend/README.md`.
AccountExport.title: AccountExport

ChatMessage.description: One message in a table's thread.
ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage

ChatPage.description: A cursor-paginated page of messages, newest first.
ChatPage.title: ChatPage

ConfirmVerificationRequest.description: Complete verification with the token from the email.
ConfirmVerificationRequest.title: ConfirmVerificationRequest

CreateAppealRequest.description: Challenge a suspension, with a written statement.
CreateAppealRequest.title: CreateAppealRequest

CreateBlockRequest.description:
Block another student.

Blocking hides content in both directions, so it also stops the
blocked user seeing the blocker.
CreateBlockRequest.title: CreateBlockRequest

CreateJoinRequest.description: Ask the host for a seat, with an optional note.
CreateJoinRequest.title: CreateJoinRequest

CreateReportRequest.description: Flag a profile, table, or message.
CreateReportRequest.title: CreateReportRequest

CreateReservationRequest.description:
Finalise a table and book it.

Party size is derived from the table's members rather than sent by
the client, so it cannot disagree with who actually has a seat.
`requested_for` defaults to the table's scheduled time.
CreateReservationRequest.title: CreateReservationRequest

CreateTableRequest.description: Host a new table. The host takes the first seat automatically.
CreateTableRequest.title: CreateTableRequest

CreateTagRequest.description: Ask for a tag that does not exist yet.
CreateTagRequest.title: CreateTagRequest

DeleteAccountResult.description:
Acknowledgement that deletion was accepted.

Attributes:
    scheduled: True once the soft delete has been recorded.
    purge_after: When the hard purge runs. Null while the retention
        window is still being decided.
DeleteAccountResult.title: DeleteAccountResult

DeviceRegistration.description: Acknowledgement that the token was stored.
DeviceRegistration.title: DeviceRegistration

DiningTable.description:
A group meal.

Attributes:
    scheduled_for: Always UTC. The client converts for display.
DiningTable.title: DiningTable

InterestTag.description:
A canonical preset tag.

Users pick from these; they cannot invent them. See `TagRequest`
for the free-text path.
InterestTag.title: InterestTag

JoinRequest.description:
A student asking for a seat.

Attributes:
    match_score: Snapshot taken when the request was made, so the
        host's view stays stable even after the scoring model
        changes.
JoinRequest.title: JoinRequest

JoinRequestStatus.description: Lifecycle of one student's request to join a table.
JoinRequestStatus.title: JoinRequestStatus

MatchCandidate.description:
One ranked person, with the score that ranked them.

Attributes:
    reasons: Human-readable drivers of the score, shown as "you
        both like ramen". Never expose raw weights to the client.
MatchCandidate.title: MatchCandidate

MatchPreview.description: A ranked slice of candidates for the caller.
MatchPreview.title: MatchPreview

PublicProfile.description:
What another student sees.

Never includes the email address or the date of birth — only the
age derived from it.
PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile

Receipt.description:
A receipt submitted against a table.

Attributes:
    total_cents: Integer minor units, never a float.
Receipt.title: Receipt

RegisterDeviceRequest.description:
Register a device for push.

The app posts its Expo push token once the user grants permission.
RegisterDeviceRequest.title: RegisterDeviceRequest

Report.description: Something a user flagged for moderation.
Report.title: Report

Reservation.description:
A booking for one table.

Attributes:
    requested_for: Always UTC.
    dispatch_channel: Which dispatcher handled it, for later
        reconciliation.
Reservation.title: Reservation

ReservationStatus.description:
Every state a reservation can occupy.

Legal moves between them live in `service.TRANSITIONS`.
ReservationStatus.title: ReservationStatus

ResolveJoinRequest.description: The host's decision on a pending request.
ResolveJoinRequest.title: ResolveJoinRequest

Restaurant.description:
One restaurant in the catalogue.

Attributes:
    price_level_cents: Rough per-head cost in integer minor units.
        Never a float — see the data conventions in the README.
    distance_km: Populated only when the request supplied a
        location.
Restaurant.title: Restaurant

SendMessageRequest.description: Post a message to a table the caller belongs to.
SendMessageRequest.title: SendMessageRequest

StartVerificationRequest.description: Begin verification for a student email address.
StartVerificationRequest.title: StartVerificationRequest

SubmitReceiptRequest.description:
Submit a receipt for a table the caller belongs to.

Attributes:
    image_path: Supabase Storage path. The client uploads the image
        directly and sends only the path, so receipt photos never
        pass through the API.
SubmitReceiptRequest.title: SubmitReceiptRequest

Suspension.description: A period during which an account cannot act.
Suspension.title: Suspension

TableMember.description: Somebody with a seat at the table.
TableMember.title: TableMember

TableStatus.description: Lifecycle of a table, from draft through to completed.
TableStatus.title: TableStatus

TagCategory.description: Which axis of a person a tag describes.
TagCategory.title: TagCategory

TagRequest.description:
Free text a user wanted as a tag, awaiting review.

Keeping free text out of the tag table is what stops the taxonomy
fragmenting into 40 spellings of "boba" and quietly breaking match
scoring.
TagRequest.title: TagRequest

UpdateProfileRequest.description:
Partial update of the caller's own profile.

`tag_ids` replaces the whole tag set when present, and leaves it
untouched when omitted.
UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest

VerificationState.description: Where the caller's verification currently stands.
VerificationState.title: VerificationState

VerificationStatus.description: Where a verification attempt has got to.
VerificationStatus.title: VerificationStatus

info.description: The only seam between the Expo app and Tablr's data. The app never talks to Postgres directly.
info.title: Tablr API
